sources.snippet: Overview paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 is a sentence embedding model created by sentence-transformers that maps sentences and paragraphs to a 384-dimensional dense vector space. The model uses a BERT architecture with 12 transformer layers and a mean pooling operation, supporting a maximum sequence length of 128 tokens.
